title: Running opencode and Checking /models
description: After configuring opencode, start it and run /models to see both Ollama and OpenWebUI entries listed with their distinct name fields, then set the agent (build or plan) which the config does not set.

steps.description: The block instructs you to start opencode, run /models to verify both providers appear, and then manually select the agent (build or plan) in the UI or terminal.
The /models command shows the union of models from both providers, distinguishable by the name field you set in the config.

steps.question: What two agents does opencode provide?
steps.answer: build (may edit files and run commands) and plan (may read and propose only)
